column1: # Seeded infrastructure — where each file came from.
# donor_path <TAB> dest (relative to src/infra/) <TAB> residual_sha256 <TAB> reason
# `residual_sha256` is the sha256 of `diff -u <donor after rename.sed> <ours>`.
# The sha of an empty diff is the well-known sha256 of the empty string,
# written here as `-` for legibility. tools/check_infra_provenance.sh recomputes
# it; `-v` prints the diff itself. A file that drifts fails the check until the
# change is deliberately re-recorded here with a reason.
# The donor is mtcp-donor @ 7fbb223c, read out of this repository's own object
# store, so nothing here depends on where anyone's checkout lives.
